title: Verify the history Details show Name, Amount (the set rate) and what it was applied to
custom_preconds: 1. A WO has (a) a whole-WO 10% fee named "Env Fee", (b) a labor-line $5.00 flat fee, (c) a part-line discount.
custom_steps:
1. Open the 'Work Order Log' (⋮ menu → Audit Log).
  2. Read the Details for a fee/discount entry.
custom_expected:
1. Details show the fee/discount Name.
  2. Details show the Amount as the SET rate (a dollar amount like '$5.00' for a flat amount, or a percentage like '10.00%'), not the resolved total.
  3. Details show what it was applied to (the whole invoice, a labor line or a part).
  4. The Fee/Discount type is shown by the event label ('Fee added' / 'Discount added').
